description: Leibniz University Hannover and Forschungszentrum Jülich publish a spatial comparison of German rainfall observations for 2006–2017. Two point shapefiles combine statistics from DWD RADKLIM and RADOLAN radar products with rain-gauge summaries, including annual and seasonal rainfall, wet-day thresholds and missing-value counts. Elevation, wind-turbine proximity and radar distance provide quality covariates, while an Excel file explains the fields. Zenodo distributes the national 1 km reference dataset freely under CC BY-SA 4.0. It can guide precipitation selection and bias checks before drainage or flood simulations. These aggregated statistics do not replace the original hourly rainfall series, and radar coverage introduces uncertainty. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
